<!-- BY SET, NEVER BY COUNT. Two different twenty-threes are a delivery that
     broke one bench and fixed another, and a counter reports that as no change.
     If the count moved, the names that moved are stated here and nowhere else.

     REFUSALS ARE NAMED AND NOT COMPARED [c-39.57]. They are facts about the
     environment the floor ran in, so they belong in the report and never in a
     base. CI passes `--refusals-fatal` and treats any refusal as red, because CI
     supplies every precondition; your container almost certainly does not. -->
